short: Build hosts from a cohomology window bound

statements.markdown: Statement 9.1 (supplyChi). For every primitive ψ, if the cohomological bound holds for ψ with exponent 401, then hosts with the required properties exist at every scale in a set containing windows of exponent 32 .

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.supplyChi
lean.plain: Build hosts from a cohomology window bound
lean.fidelity_note: SupplyChi.lean:8–9 has the same premise VWinAt ψ 401. Its HostExW conclusion gives uniform host constants for each 0 < ε < 1/52 and hosts on arbitrarily late windows [Y,Y^(3/2)] carrying both EAtH and the cohomology bound at the actual block width.

statements.markdown: The only assumption about ψ is its cohomological bound. The windows come from Statement 8.1, which holds on windows [Y 1 , Y 1 2 ]; this is why Statement 4.1 is needed in its windowed form.

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.supplyChi
lean.plain: Build hosts from a cohomology window bound
lean.note: SupplyChi.lean:8–11 takes only VWinAt ψ 401. Its proof invokes supplyOfAdm, which gets windows of exponent 3/2 through winPairs and the proved good-pair supply.

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.VWin
lean.plain: Cohomology bound on windows for all characters
lean.note: ExistsPageN.lean:44–49 packages VWinAt ψ 401 for each primitive ψ. VWinAt supplies the square window for eligible prime pairs and each choice of PageN schedule. WinPairs.lean:34–52 fits the rescaled exponent-3/2 window inside it.
